text: Defined the revert mechanism as a Reverts: trailer naming a resolvable commit, whose message is parsed for the bump, with PATCH as the floor. The previous wording said the commit 'states' the bump and never said how; neither Conventional Commits nor the parser has such a field, so two implementations could read one history and publish different versions. Assumed a trailer is the right shape and that PATCH is a safe floor for an unresolvable reference
